about_the_game:
Froggy Brews is a delightful 2D hand-drawn game that allows players to immerse themselves in the charming world of tea-making. You play Froggy, a lonely teamaker who struggles to figure out the best blends for his customers. However, as he delves deeper into their lives, he notices the cracks and holes that they hide away and must do everything in his power to hold the village together, one cup of tea at a time.

EXPLORE & FORAGE

Wander through the lush and colorful biomes, filled with an array of flora, as you hunt for special and rare ingredients that thrive in the enchanting landscapes of Bloomville.

BREW UNIQUE BLENDS

Create delightful and innovative tea blends that will enchant beloved customers and elevate their tea-drinking experience.

UNLOCK MEMORIES

Discover the stories that have been tucked away with certain tea blends that reveal pieces of Froggy's past.

short_description: Froggy Brews is a gentle narrative puzzle adventure, where you play as a tea-loving frog returning to your old neighborhood — it has changed over time, and so have you. You brew delicious tea, try to connect with unfamiliar faces, and help others heal as you rediscover your place in this world.
